title: Claws (Cat)
html:
This article is about the version of the ability used by cats. For other uses, see Claws (disambiguation).
Claws is a  Wild Shape: Cat and  Find Familiar: Cat action. Cats use this ability to make melee attacks and deal slashing damage to enemies that try to rub their bellies.

Description

Lash out with deadly claws.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Damage: 2
2⁠Slashing
Details
 Melee Unarmed Attack Roll
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)

At higher levels

  • At Level 4, this attack deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Slashing damage.
  • At Level 8, this additional damage becomes 1d6⁠⁠Slashing.
  • At Level 12, this additional damage becomes 1d8⁠⁠Slashing.
